returns: Items can be returned within 15 days of delivery in original condition and packaging. Gifting-category items are final sale once the card message has been personalized. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5-7 business days of the return being received.
shipping: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days and is free on orders over ₹999; orders below that carry a flat ₹49 shipping fee. Express 1-day shipping is available at checkout for an additional ₹149 in metro cities.
warranty: Electronics (audio category) carry a 1-year manufacturer warranty covering defects in materials and workmanship, excluding accidental damage or water damage beyond the stated IP rating. Home and apparel items are not separately warrantied beyond the standard 15-day return window.
